name: qiansi
description: Qiansi: a local-first canvas where every AI model is a teammate.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,studio -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @qiansi/server" "npm run dev -w @qiansi/studio"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @qiansi/engine && npm run typecheck -w @qiansi/server && npm run typecheck -w @qiansi/cli && npm run typecheck -w @qiansi/studio
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -n server,studio,desktop -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @qiansi/server" "npm run dev -w @qiansi/studio" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && node scripts/desktop-dev.mjs"
scripts.desktop:portable: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && node scripts/desktop-portable.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.yml --publish never
